features.howToVerify: Open the Studio settings screen (the gear in the rail, or /barn/settings if it exists), confirm the third row uses a lock glyph rather than a check, and that the publish dialog's credential scan matches the second half of the claim.
features.notes: icon/lock 21:941, title 21:945, detail 21:946. This is the setting side of screen 07's 'No credentials in the diff' pre-flight check. Detail 21:946 reads 'Never sent. Redacted before the request leaves Rancher, and scanned again before publish.'

features.name: Settings apply without an explicit save
features.promise: The page has no Save or Apply button anywhere, so every control on it is drawn as taking effect the moment it is changed.
features.howToVerify: Open the Studio settings screen (the gear in the rail, or /barn/settings if it exists), change one control, navigate away and back, and check the change persisted with no save step.
features.notes: Inferred from an absence: the frame ends at the last card (21:923) with no footer or action bar. The permission card explicitly says its change 'takes effect on the next message', which supports immediate application.
